DECLARE

BEGIN

           '; ' ORDER BY authorization_id::text

    INTO conflict
  FROM (
    SELECT authorization_id,
           string_agg(id::text, ', ' ORDER BY id::text) AS job_ids
    FROM "os"."apply_jobs"
    WHERE status = 'succeeded'
    GROUP BY authorization_id
    HAVING count(*) > 1
  ) duplicates;

  IF conflict IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      '0007_service_actor_constraints: multiple succeeded apply jobs share an authorization: %',
      conflict;
  END IF;

  SELECT string_agg(
           format('%s (%s)', authorization_id::text, job_ids),
           '; ' ORDER BY authorization_id::text
         )
    INTO conflict
  FROM (
    SELECT authorization_id,
           string_agg(id::text, ', ' ORDER BY id::text) AS job_ids
    FROM "os"."apply_jobs"
    WHERE status = 'succeeded'
       OR response_json->'writes' = 'true'::jsonb
       OR (
         jsonb_typeof(response_json->'outcomes') = 'array'
         AND jsonb_array_length(response_json->'outcomes') > 0
       )
    GROUP BY authorization_id
    HAVING count(*) > 1
  ) duplicates;

  IF conflict IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      '0007_service_actor_constraints: multiple apply jobs recorded platform writes or outcomes for one authorization: %',
      conflict;
  END IF;

  DELETE FROM "os"."apply_jobs" AS extra
  WHERE extra.id IN (
    SELECT id
    FROM (
      SELECT id,
             row_number() OVER (
               PARTITION BY authorization_id
               ORDER BY
                 CASE
                   WHEN status = 'succeeded'
                     OR response_json->'writes' = 'true'::jsonb
                     OR (
                       jsonb_typeof(response_json->'outcomes') = 'array'
                       AND jsonb_array_length(response_json->'outcomes') > 0
                     )
                   THEN 0
                   ELSE 1
                 END,
                 created_at DESC,
                 id DESC
             ) AS n
      FROM "os"."apply_jobs"
    ) ranked
    WHERE n > 1
  )
  AND extra.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'succeeded'
  AND extra.response_json->'writes' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
  AND NOT COALESCE(
    jsonb_typeof(extra.response_json->'outcomes') = 'array'
    AND jsonb_array_length(extra.response_json->'outcomes') > 0,

-- Backfill rows that already existed. Idempotent: a second run matches nothing,
-- because authorized and denied rows are no longer PENDING_APPROVAL.
UPDATE "os"."recommendations" AS r
SET "approval_json" = jsonb_build_object(
	'status', CASE WHEN r.status = 'denied' THEN 'rejected' ELSE 'approved' END,
	'approved_by', NULL,
	'approved_at', to_char(r.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
	'executed_by', CASE
		WHEN EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM "os"."apply_jobs" AS j
			INNER JOIN "os"."authorizations" AS a ON a.id = j.authorization_id
			WHERE a.recommendation_id = r.id
				AND j.status = 'succeeded'
				AND COALESCE(j.response_json->>'writes', 'false') = 'true'
		) THEN 'cerevex_apply'
		ELSE NULL
	END,
	'executed_at', (
		SELECT to_char(COALESCE(j.finished_at, j.created_at) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"')
		FROM "os"."apply_jobs" AS j
		INNER JOIN "os"."authorizations" AS a ON a.id = j.authorization_id
		WHERE a.recommendation_id = r.id
			AND j.status = 'succeeded'
			AND COALESCE(j.response_json->>'writes', 'false') = 'true'
		ORDER BY COALESCE(j.finished_at, j.created_at) DESC, j.id DESC
		LIMIT 1
	),
	'apply_result', CASE
		WHEN EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM "os"."apply_jobs" AS j
			INNER JOIN "os"."authorizations" AS a ON a.id = j.authorization_id
			WHERE a.recommendation_id = r.id
				AND j.status = 'succeeded'
				AND COALESCE(j.response_json->>'writes', 'false') = 'true'
		) THEN 'legacy apply'
		ELSE NULL
	END,
	'rolled_back_by', NULL,
	'rolled_back_at', NULL
)
WHERE r.status IN ('authorized', 'denied')
	AND r.approval_json->>'status' = 'PENDING_APPROVAL'
	AND r.approval_json->>'approved_at' IS NULL
	AND r.approval_json->>'executed_at' IS NULL;
